items.title: Pete Barbutti interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 8, 2022
items.q: So I started yelling at this guy who was the manager. His name was Mr. McClusky.

ctx.x: and for some reason it popped into my head. But George Burke set it up and it was my first single ever and so I was terrified. And I said, “George I’m ashamed to tell you I don’t have the money to get to Spokane and I don’t have a car.” So he said, “Well take the bus.” I said, “Okay but it takes like a day and a half to get there on the bus.” It stopped everywhere, you know, Fresno and Elko, and so George Burke said, “Okay I’ll send you a money order.” This was before you could transfer money. And so I said,…

the next night and I’m not exaggerating, he had a cord hanging down from the ceiling and a 100 watt bulb with like a poolroom shade over it.” And I’d go [scats] and turn on the light and everybody’d go whoa [shields eyes] you know it was dark in the room. And then I said, Rocky, with this piano like this I can’t see the people.” So the next invention of his was on top of the piano he mounted a mirror from a dresser and it would swivel. And he gave me a dowel so I could reach up and move the mirror. My final…
You’ve come a long way, baby.
